_about: Real raw ConPTY output (Windows 11, PS 5.1 host) of Claude Code 2.1.302, Codex 0.153.4 and Antigravity CLI 1.4.x in terminals that are not 80x24 (GitHub #36): narrow, wide, and one resized after it went idle. raw is what readOutput(terminalId, 1000) returned; cols and rows are the PTY's size then; truth is what the status detector reads on @xterm/headless at that size. Personal strings replaced by ones of equal length.
